This page is made from the `#[component]` functions in
[`aurora-leptos/src/`](https://github.com/colliery-io/aurora/tree/main/aurora-leptos/src)
and their doc comments. For the types that the props take (`ApiError`,
`DagNode`, `LogLine`, ...), see the
[API reference on docs.rs](https://docs.rs/colliery-io-aurora). To see each
component on a page, [run the gallery](../../how-to/run-the-gallery/).

"Default" is the value of a prop that you do not give. "Optional" means the
prop is empty when you do not give it (an empty string, `false`, `None`).
A prop marked "required" must be given.

A prop of type `Signal<T>` takes a value, a signal or a closure. A prop of
type `Option<Callback<T>>` takes a `Callback::new(...)`.

## Stylesheet

`use aurora_leptos::AuroraStyles;`

### AuroraStyles

Puts the full Aurora stylesheet in an inline `<style>`. `hyper=true` adds the opt-in hyper theme. A linked stylesheet has no first-paint flash: see [Load the stylesheet as a file](../../how-to/link-the-stylesheet/).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `hyper` | `bool` | optional |

## Theme

`use aurora_leptos::theme::ThemeToggle;`

### ThemeToggle

A Light / Dark / System control. Put it in a top bar.

The choice changes the page at once and is stored in the browser.
Each button tells assistive technology whether it is pressed.

`hyper=true` adds a Hyper button (Light / Dark / Hyper / System). Load
`HYPER_CSS` too, or Hyper shows the system theme.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `hyper` | `bool` | optional |

## Primitives

`use aurora_leptos::components::*;`

### Group

A horizontal flex row.

- `justify`: `"between"` or `"end"` (default: the start).
- `align`: the cross axis. `"center"` (default), `"start"`, `"end"` (the
  bottom edge: a labelled field and a button line up on the control),
  `"baseline"` or `"stretch"`. `top=true` is the same as `align="start"`.
- `wrap`, `gap` (`"xs"`, `"sm"`; default `md`).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `justify` | `String` | optional |
| `top` | `bool` | optional |
| `align` | `String` | optional |
| `wrap` | `bool` | optional |
| `gap` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Stack

A vertical flex column. `gap`: `"xs"` or `"sm"` (default `md`). `center` centres the children.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `center` | `bool` | optional |
| `gap` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Text

A paragraph of text. `size`: `"xs"`, `"sm"` or `"lg"`. `dimmed`, `bright`, `bold` and `mono` change its look.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `String` | optional |
| `dimmed` | `bool` | optional |
| `bright` | `bool` | optional |
| `bold` | `bool` | optional |
| `mono` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Button

A button.

- `variant`: `"filled"` (default), `"light"`, `"default"` or `"subtle"`.
  `"primary"` is the same as `"filled"`.
- `size`: `"xs"`, `"sm"` (default) or `"md"`. `bad`: the danger colour.
- `disabled`: a `bool`, a signal or a closure (`disabled=move || busy.get()`).
- `loading`: while true, the button shows a spinner, is disabled and has
  `aria-busy="true"`. With `loading_label`, that text replaces the
  children while it loads ("Saving…").
- `button_type`: the `type` attribute (`"submit"` in a form). Not set by
  default, so a button in a `<form>` submits it, as before.
- `href`: draws a link (`<a>`) that looks like the button.
- `title`, `aria_label`: the tooltip and the accessible name (give
  `aria_label` when the children are only an icon). A `String`, a signal
  or a closure, so they can change (AURORA-T-0013 item 13).
- `stop_propagation`: the click does not go on to a parent (a button in
  a clickable table row or card).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `String` | `"filled"` |
| `size` | `String` | `"sm"` |
| `bad` | `bool` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `loading` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `loading_label` | `String` | optional |
| `button_type` | `String` | optional |
| `href` | `String` | optional |
| `title` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `aria_label` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `stop_propagation` | `bool` | optional |
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### TextInput

A one-line text field, bound to `value`.

- `label`, `placeholder`, `error` (a red border and a message under it).
  `error` takes a `String`, a `&str`, a signal or a closure, so the
  message can change while the field is shown.
- `id`: the `id` of the `<input>`, for a `<label for=…>` outside the
  component. Default: a unique id.
- `aria_label`: the accessible name when there is no visible `label`.
- `input_type`: the `type` attribute, `"text"` by default (`"email"`,
  `"url"`, `"search"`, `"date"`, `"password"`...).
- `disabled`: a `bool`, a signal or a closure.
- `on_input`: runs with the new text on each key press (after `value`
  changes). `on_change`: runs when the person leaves the field or presses
  Enter after a change.
- `name`, `autocomplete`, `required`, `spellcheck`: the HTML attributes
  (for forms and password managers).
- `mono`: the text in the mono font (ids, codes).
- `description`: a help line under the field, linked to it with
  `aria-describedby`. A `String`, a signal or a closure.
- `described_by`: more ids for `aria-describedby` (a help text elsewhere).
- `required` also marks the label with `*`.
- `autofocus`: focus the field when it is mounted.
- `maxlength`, `min`, `max`, `step`: the HTML attributes.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `placeholder` | `String` | optional |
| `value` | `RwSignal<String>` | required |
| `error` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `input_type` | `String` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `on_input` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional |
| `on_change` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional |
| `name` | `String` | optional |
| `autocomplete` | `String` | optional |
| `required` | `bool` | optional |
| `spellcheck` | `Option<bool>` | optional |
| `mono` | `bool` | optional |
| `id` | `String` | optional |
| `aria_label` | `String` | optional |
| `description` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `described_by` | `String` | optional |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | optional |
| `maxlength` | `Option<u32>` | optional |
| `min` | `String` | optional |
| `max` | `String` | optional |
| `step` | `String` | optional |

### Select

A native select, bound to `value`.

- `options`: the choices, where the value and the text are the same.
- `option_pairs`: `(value, label)` choices, where the text differs from
  the value (`("42", "COLLIERY-T-42 · Fix the pager")`). Shown after
  `options`.
- `placeholder`: a first choice with the value `""` (such as "Choose a
  board" or "(none)").
- `aria_label`: the accessible name when there is no visible `label`.
  (`attr:aria-label` goes on the wrapper `<div>`, not on the `<select>`.)
- `id`: the `id` of the `<select>`, for a `<label for=…>` outside the
  component. Default: a unique id.
- `disabled`, `on_change` (runs with the new value), `name`, `required`,
  `error` (a `String`, a `&str`, a signal or a closure).
- `description`, `described_by`, `autofocus`: as on `TextInput`.

`options` and `option_pairs` take a `Vec`, a signal or a closure: when
they change, the select shows the new choices (AURORA-T-0013 item 11).

When `value` matches no option and there is no placeholder, the select
shows the first option, as a native select does. `value` itself is not
changed.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `options` | `Signal<Vec<String>>` | optional |
| `option_pairs` | `Signal<Vec<(String, String)>>` | optional |
| `value` | `RwSignal<String>` | required |
| `placeholder` | `String` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `on_change` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional |
| `name` | `String` | optional |
| `required` | `bool` | optional |
| `error` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `id` | `String` | optional |
| `aria_label` | `String` | optional |
| `description` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `described_by` | `String` | optional |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | optional |

### Tooltip

A short text that shows over its trigger on hover and on keyboard focus.

- `label`: the text. It is also the accessible description of the
  trigger (`aria-describedby` on the first control inside).
- `position`: `"top"` (default), `"bottom"`, `"left"` or `"right"`.
- `focusable`: the wrapper takes keyboard focus. Use it when the trigger
  is not a control (a pill, an icon, an inline SVG).

It shows after a short delay, and at once for keyboard focus. Escape
hides it. It is pure CSS, so a parent with `overflow: hidden` can cut it:
use `position` to keep it inside. For a plain hint on truncated text, a
`title` attribute is enough. Inside an SVG chart, use an SVG `<title>`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `position` | `String` | optional |
| `focusable` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Pill

A small tinted label. Give it a hue token (`token::OK`): the text is `--x-fg` on the `--x-bg` fill. Any other colour gets an 11% tint.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `String` | required |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### StatusBadge

A status as a pill. The hue comes from `status_color(status)`: running is ice, completed ok, failed bad, scheduled violet, pending and paused muted, cancelled gold, skipped skip. Any other text is muted. The case does not matter.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `String` | required |

### Dot

A small round status dot in `color`. `size` is in px. `glow` adds a soft ring.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `String` | required |
| `size` | `i32` | `8` |
| `glow` | `bool` | optional |

### Panel

A card surface with a title and an optional caption.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `String` | required |
| `caption` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Chip

A filter chip: a toggle button.

- `label`, `count` (shown when 0 or more), `active`, `on_click`. `count`
  takes a number, a signal or a closure, so a live count updates
  (AURORA-T-0013 item 10).

It is a `type="button"` (it does not submit a form) with `aria-pressed`
from `active`, so a screen reader says whether the filter is on.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `count` | `Signal<i32>` | `Signal::stored(-1)` |
| `active` | `Signal<bool>` | required |
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |

### Loading

The "loading" state of a view: a spinner and a label.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | `"Loading…"` |

### Empty

An empty state: a message, and an optional next step.

- `message`: what is empty ("No agents yet.").
- `hint` (optional): the next step, in a smaller line under it ("Install
  an agent to see it here.").
- `href` + `link` (optional): a link after the hint ("Read how", the
  default text when only `href` is given).
- children (optional): any next-step content (a button, a link) under the
  message and the hint.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | `String` | required |
| `hint` | `String` | optional |
| `href` | `String` | optional |
| `link` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Option<Children>` | optional |

### ErrorState

The "error" state of a view. It classifies the `ApiError` (not authorised, not found, invalid, server, network) and shows a retry button when `on_retry` is given and the error can be retried.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | `ApiError` | required |
| `on_retry` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |

Hairline rule (Mantine `Divider`).

No props.

### Loader

Standalone spinner (Mantine `Loader`).

- `size`: `"xs"` (14px, for a line of text or a button), `"sm"` (20px) or
  `"md"` (32px, default).
- `label` (optional): the accessible name ("Loading runs"). With a label
  the spinner is a `role="status"`; with none it is hidden from screen
  readers, for a place that says it is busy another way.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `String` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |

### Skeleton

A grey placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.

- `width`, `height` (CSS lengths): default `100%` and `1em`.
- `lines`: draw that many lines of text instead (the last one shorter).
- `circle`: a circle of `height` (an avatar).

It is hidden from screen readers: say "loading" another way (a
`Loader` with a label, or `aria-busy` on the region). The shimmer stops
when the OS asks for reduced motion.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `width` | `String` | optional |
| `height` | `String` | optional |
| `lines` | `usize` | optional |
| `circle` | `bool` | optional |

### Accordion

A group of `Disclosure`s. By default one is open at a time: opening one
closes the others (the HTML `name` of `<details>`). `multiple`: any number
can be open.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `multiple` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Disclosure

A section that a person opens and closes: a native `<details>` with a
`<summary>`, so the keyboard and screen readers work with no script.

- `title`: the always-visible line.
- `open` (optional): the open state, as a signal to read or set. With none,
  the section starts closed (or `default_open`) and keeps its own state.
- Inside an `Accordion`, opening one section closes the others.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `open` | `Option<RwSignal<bool>>` | optional |
| `default_open` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### ActionIcon

Square icon-only button (Mantine `ActionIcon`).

- `aria_label`: the accessible name. Give it: the children are an icon.
  With none, the `title` is the name.
- `title`: the tooltip.
- `disabled`: a `bool`, a signal or a closure.
- `button_type`: the `type` attribute, `"button"` by default, so the
  button does not submit a form (AURORA-T-0013 item 12).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `aria_label` | `Signal<String>` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `button_type` | `String` | `"button"` |
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Alert

Tinted callout (Mantine `Alert`). `color` is a hex/token value used for the
accent (defaults to the bad/red token). Powers `ErrorState` too.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `String` | optional |
| `color` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### Switch

Toggle (Mantine `Switch`), controlled by a bool signal.

A real `<button role="switch">`, not a clickable `<span>` — which is what this
was (KAIROS-T-0198). The span version had a worse problem than the missing
label association that ticket was filed about: it was not a control at all. No
role, no state, not focusable, not keyboard-operable. A keyboard user could not
toggle it and a screen reader saw two pieces of decorative text.

A `<button>` gets focus, Enter and Space for free; `role="switch"` plus
`aria-checked` gives it the on/off state; and the label lives INSIDE the
button, which makes it the accessible name with no `for`/`id` needed. The
label is also then part of the click target, which it always looked like it
was.

- `disabled`: a `bool`, a signal or a closure.
- `on_change`: runs with the new state after a click.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `RwSignal<bool>` | required |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `on_change` | `Option<Callback<bool>>` | optional |

### Menu

A dropdown of actions off a trigger button. Put `MenuItem`s in it (and
`MenuLabel` / `MenuDivider`).

- `label`: the text of the default trigger (a default button with a
  chevron). Or `trigger`: your own trigger content (a tenant name with a
  dot, an icon); `trigger_class` styles it (default: a plain, full-width
  row). Give `aria_label` when the trigger is only an icon.
- `align`: `"start"` (default) or `"end"` (the right edges line up, for a
  menu at the right of a bar). `up`: open above the trigger (a menu at
  the bottom of a sidebar).
- `open` (optional): hold the open state in your own signal.

Keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens it on the first
item, ArrowUp on the last. ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End move. Escape
closes it and gives focus back to the trigger; Tab closes it. A click
outside closes it. An item runs its action and closes the menu.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `trigger` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `trigger_class` | `String` | optional |
| `aria_label` | `String` | optional |
| `align` | `String` | optional |
| `up` | `bool` | optional |
| `open` | `Option<RwSignal<bool>>` | optional |
| `children` | `ChildrenFn` | required |

### MenuItem

An item in a `Menu`. It runs `on_click` (or opens `href`), closes the
menu, and gives focus back to the trigger.

- `disabled`: a `bool`, a signal or a closure; the item stays in the list
  but does nothing.
- `danger`: the danger colour (delete, remove).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `href` | `String` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `danger` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### MenuLabel

A small heading for a group of items in a `Menu`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### MenuDivider

A line between groups of items in a `Menu`.

No props.

### CopyButton

A button that copies `value` to the clipboard and says so.

- `value`: a string or a signal.
- `icon`: a square icon button (a copy icon that turns into a tick) in
  place of the text button.
- `link`: `value` is a path (`/items/K-1`); it copies the absolute URL.
- `label` (default "Copy"): the text, or the accessible name of the icon
  button. `copied_label` (default "Copied"): the text after a copy.
- `on_copy` (optional): runs with the copied text.

The button is not there when the browser has no Clipboard API (a page on
plain HTTP), so there is never a button that does nothing. It confirms
only after the copy worked, and a screen reader hears "Copied" (an
`aria-live` region). A click does not go on to a clickable parent (a
table row).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `icon` | `bool` | optional |
| `link` | `bool` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | `"Copy"` |
| `copied_label` | `String` | `"Copied"` |
| `on_copy` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional |

### Table

A styled table (Mantine `Table`). Put `<thead>`, `<tbody>`, `<tr>`,
`<th>` and `<td>` in it, or the helpers: `TableRow` (a clickable row),
`SortHeader` (a header cell that sorts) and `TableEmpty`.

- `mono`: tabular mono cells.
- `fixed`: a fixed layout (`table-layout: fixed`): the columns keep their
  widths, and long text is cut with "…".
- `widths`: the column widths (`vec!["22%".into(), "52px".into()]`), as a
  `<colgroup>`. Two tables with the same widths line up.
- `label`: the accessible name of the table.
- `min_width` (optional, such as `"640px"`): the table does not get
  narrower than this; on a small screen it scrolls sideways in its own
  box, and the page does not.

The class `cl-num` on a `th` or `td` aligns a number to the right.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `mono` | `bool` | optional |
| `fixed` | `bool` | optional |
| `widths` | `Vec<String>` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `min_width` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### TableRow

A table row that a person can click or open with the keyboard.

- `on_click`: runs on a click on the row, and on Enter or Space when the
  row has focus. A click on a link, a button or a field inside the row
  goes to that control, not to the row.
- `selected`: shows the row as the selected one.
- `label` (optional): the accessible name of the row (for example the
  name of the item it opens).

With no `on_click` it is a plain `<tr>`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `selected` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### SortHeader

A header cell that sorts the table by `key`.

A click (or Enter / Space) sets `sort`: a new column starts ascending
(`first_desc`: descending, for times and counts), a second click flips
it. The cell has `aria-sort`. Sort the rows yourself from `sort`, for
example with `rows.sort_by(|a, b| s.order(a.name.cmp(&b.name)))`.

`align_right` aligns the header of a number column; `width` sets the
width of the column.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `key` | `String` | required |
| `sort` | `RwSignal<crate::data::SortState>` | required |
| `first_desc` | `bool` | optional |
| `align_right` | `bool` | optional |
| `width` | `String` | optional |

### TableEmpty

A row that says the table has no rows. `colspan` is the number of
columns.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | `String` | required |
| `colspan` | `u32` | `1` |

## Frame

`use aurora_leptos::components::*;`

### AppShell

The app scaffold: a header across the top, a sidebar, and the main area.

- `header` (optional): the top bar content (search, user menu, theme toggle).
- `navbar` (optional): the sidebar content, usually a `SideNav`. Leave it
  out for a top-bar-only app.
- `brand` (optional): the product mark and name. It shows in the header;
  with no `header` it shows at the top of the sidebar.
- `contained`: draw the shell as a bordered panel of fixed height (for docs
  and galleries). By default the shell fills the page.
- `menu_label`: the accessible name of the menu button (default "Menu").
- `nav_open` (optional): the open state of the drawer, as your own signal.
  With none, the shell makes one. Either way it is in the context as an
  `AppShellNav` (`use_app_shell`).
- `main_id`, `main_class` (optional): the `id` and more classes of the
  `<main>`. With an id, `<main>` also has `tabindex="-1"`, so a skip link
  can move focus to it.
- `skip_link` (optional): the text of a skip link ("Skip to content"). It
  is the first element of the shell, so it is the first Tab stop, and it
  shows only when it has focus. It goes to `main_id` (default `"main"`).
- `breakpoint` (optional): the width in px below which the sidebar is a
  drawer. Default `APPSHELL_BREAKPOINT` (768).

Below the breakpoint the sidebar leaves the layout. A menu button in the
header opens it as a drawer from the left, and the page under it does not
scroll. Escape, a click on the scrim, or a click on a link closes it, and
focus goes back to the menu button. When the window gets wider than the
breakpoint, the drawer closes.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `navbar` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `brand` | `Option<ChildrenFn>` | optional |
| `contained` | `bool` | optional |
| `menu_label` | `String` | `"Menu"` |
| `nav_open` | `Option<RwSignal<bool>>` | optional |
| `main_id` | `String` | optional |
| `main_class` | `String` | optional |
| `skip_link` | `String` | optional |
| `breakpoint` | `Option<u32>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### SideNav

The sidebar navigation: a `<nav>` landmark with groups of links and an
optional footer (scope switcher, user, sign-out) pinned to the bottom.

Put `SideNavGroup`s and `SideNavLink`s inside. `label` is the name of
the landmark (default "Main").

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | `"Main"` |
| `footer` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### SideNavGroup

A group of `SideNavLink`s with an optional label ("Orchestration",
"System"). With a label, the group is an ARIA `group` named by it.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### SideNavLink

One link in a `SideNav`: a plain `<a href>`, so it works with or without
a router (leptos_router handles clicks on plain anchors).

- `active`: a bool, a signal or a closure (`move || path.get() == "/runs"`).
  The active link gets `aria-current="page"`.
- `count` (optional): a badge after the label. `count_color` sets its hue
  (a token, e.g. `token::BAD`); by default it is neutral.
- `marker` (optional): a small coloured square before the label (a token).
- `icon` (optional): an icon before the label.
- `on_click` (optional): runs on click (for apps that route with a signal).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `href` | `String` | required |
| `active` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `count` | `MaybeProp<usize>` | optional |
| `count_color` | `String` | optional |
| `marker` | `String` | optional |
| `icon` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### PageHeader

The page title block.

- `title`: the page name, in an `<h1>`.
- `sub` (optional): a mono line under the title (an id, a path, a count).
- `back_href` + `back_label` (optional): a "← Executions" link above the
  title. The label defaults to "Back".
- `meta` (optional): a line of pills or facts under the title.
- `actions` (optional): buttons on the right. `right` is the older name of
  the same slot and still works; when both are given, both show.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `String` | required |
| `sub` | `String` | optional |
| `right` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `back_href` | `String` | optional |
| `back_label` | `String` | optional |
| `meta` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `actions` | `Option<Children>` | optional |

### Modal

A dialog over the page, open while `open` is true.

- `title`: shown in the header; also the accessible name of the dialog.
  A `String`, a `&str`, a signal or a closure, so it can name the item
  ("Delete fx-demo?") and change while the dialog is open.
- `size`: `"sm"` (400px), `"md"` (520px, default), `"lg"` (760px) or
  `"xl"` (1060px). On a small screen the dialog is the screen width less a
  16px margin.
- `footer` (optional): buttons in a bar under the body, on the right.
- `close_on_scrim` (default true): a click on the dim area closes it.
- `locked` (optional): while true, Escape, the scrim and × do not close it
  (use it while a request runs).
- `on_close` (optional): runs when the person closes the dialog with
  Escape, the scrim or ×.

- `in_place`: render the dialog where the component is. By default it is
  moved to the end of `<body>` when it opens, so no rule of the page can
  shrink or clip it.

On open, focus moves into the dialog: to an element with
`data-autofocus`, else the first control in the body, else the footer.
Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside. On close, focus goes back to the element
that had it before.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `RwSignal<bool>` | required |
| `title` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `size` | `String` | optional |
| `footer` | `Option<ChildrenFn>` | optional |
| `close_on_scrim` | `bool` | `true` |
| `locked` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `on_close` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `in_place` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `ChildrenFn` | required |

### Drawer

A panel that slides in from the right, over a scrim (a detail view).

Same props and keyboard behaviour as `Modal`. `size`: `"sm"` (360px),
`"md"` (430px, default), `"lg"` (640px) or `"xl"` (860px); never wider than
92% of the screen.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `RwSignal<bool>` | required |
| `title` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `size` | `String` | optional |
| `footer` | `Option<ChildrenFn>` | optional |
| `close_on_scrim` | `bool` | `true` |
| `locked` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `on_close` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `in_place` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `ChildrenFn` | required |

### ConfirmDialog

A confirmation for an action that destroys or changes data.

- `title`: the question ("Delete workflow?"). A `String`, a `&str`, a
  signal or a closure (`title=move || format!("Delete {}?", name.get())`).
- `message` (optional): what happens, in one or two sentences.
- `impacts` (optional): a list of what the action also changes (for
  example the items an archive cascades to), under `impacts_label`.
- `confirm_text` (optional): the person must type this text (a name) to
  enable the confirm button.
- `confirm_label` / `cancel_label`: button text ("Confirm" / "Cancel").
- `danger` (default true): the confirm button is red.
- `busy` (optional): while true, the buttons are disabled, the confirm
  button shows a spinner, and the dialog does not close.
- `on_confirm`: runs when the person confirms. The dialog stays open: set
  `open` to false when the work is done (or at once).
- `on_cancel` (optional): runs on Cancel, Escape, the scrim or ×. The
  dialog closes itself.
- `notice` (optional): content between the message and the impacts list,
  such as a warning that must be read before the list.
- children (optional): more content under the list (an error, a preview).
- `initial_focus`: the button that has focus when the dialog opens,
  `"cancel"` (default) or `"confirm"`. With `confirm_text`, the text field
  has it.
- `alert`: `role="alertdialog"`, for a question the person must answer
  now; the message is its description, and a click on the scrim does not
  close it (AURORA-T-0013 item 17).
- `in_place`: as on `Modal`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `RwSignal<bool>` | required |
| `title` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `message` | `String` | optional |
| `impacts` | `Signal<Vec<String>>` | optional |
| `impacts_label` | `String` | `"This also changes:"` |
| `confirm_text` | `String` | optional |
| `confirm_label` | `String` | `"Confirm"` |
| `cancel_label` | `String` | `"Cancel"` |
| `danger` | `bool` | `true` |
| `busy` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `size` | `String` | `"sm"` |
| `on_confirm` | `Callback<()>` | required |
| `on_cancel` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `notice` | `Option<ChildrenFn>` | optional |
| `children` | `Option<ChildrenFn>` | optional |
| `initial_focus` | `String` | `"cancel"` |
| `alert` | `bool` | optional |
| `in_place` | `bool` | optional |

### ToastStack

The stack of toasts at the bottom right. Mount it once, near the app root.

- `duration_ms` (default 5000): time on screen of a toast. The timers stop
  while the pointer is over the stack or focus is in it.
- `toaster` (optional): the queue to show. By default the one in the
  context; if there is none, the stack makes one and provides it.

A click on a toast dismisses it. Motion stops when the OS asks for reduced
motion.

Screen readers hear each new toast from two live regions that the stack
keeps on the page from the start: errors from an assertive one
(`role="alert"`), the others from a polite one (`role="status"`). A region
that comes with its text is often not read (AURORA-T-0013 item 15).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `duration_ms` | `u64` | `5000` |
| `toaster` | `Option<Toaster>` | optional |

### Tabs

A tab list with an underline, and the panels under it.

- `tabs`: the tabs (`TabItem`).
- `value`: the selected tab's value. A click or an arrow key sets it.
- `label` (optional): the accessible name of the tab list.
- children (optional): `TabPanel`s. Leave them out for route tabs, where
  the page under the tabs is the router outlet.

Signal tabs are buttons: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / Home / End move focus and
select. Route tabs (a `TabItem::href`) are links: the arrow keys move
focus, and Enter opens the link; set `value` from the route.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | `Vec<TabItem>` | required |
| `value` | `RwSignal<String>` | required |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Option<Children>` | optional |

### TabPanel

The content of one tab. Put it inside `Tabs`; `value` matches a
`TabItem::value`. Only the selected panel renders its children.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `String` | required |
| `children` | `ChildrenFn` | required |

### Card

A panel with no header, for grids of things (boards, flows, agents).

- `href` (optional): the card is a link (`<a>`).
- `on_click` (optional): the card is a button (`role="button"`, focusable,
  Enter and Space run it). With `href` too, it runs on click of the link.
- `title` (optional): a bold first line.
- `label` (optional): the accessible name, when the content is not a good
  one.
- `selected` (optional): draws the card as selected.

With neither `href` nor `on_click`, the card is a static panel. An
interactive card has hover and focus states.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `href` | `String` | optional |
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `title` | `String` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `selected` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### SecretReveal

Shows a secret one time (a new API key, a token, a recovery code): a
warning line, the secret in a mono block with a copy button, and an "I
saved it" button.

Put it in a `Modal` with `close_on_scrim=false`, and clear the secret
in `on_done`, so the secret is not in memory after the person closes it.

- `secret`: the text to show.
- `label` (optional): what the secret is ("API key"), above the block.
- `warning` (default: "Copy this now. You cannot see it again after you
  close this."): the line at the top.
- `done_label` (default "I saved it") and `on_done`: the close button.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `secret` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `warning` | `String` | `"Copy this now. You cannot see it again after you close this."` |
| `done_label` | `String` | `"I saved it"` |
| `on_done` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |

### CenterScreen

A full-screen area with its content in the centre, on the page
background: for sign-in, the OAuth callback, and "no access" or "loading
the session" states. Put an `AuthCard` in it.

`contained`: a fixed height (360px) in place of the full screen, for a
gallery or a docs page.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `contained` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### AuthCard

A centred card for a sign-in form or a gate state.

- `brand` (optional): the product mark, at the top.
- `title`: an `<h1>`. `sub` (optional): a line under it.
- `children`: the form, a `Loading`, an `Alert`, a button.
- `footer` (optional): a line at the bottom (a link to help, the
  version).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `String` | required |
| `sub` | `String` | optional |
| `brand` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `footer` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

`use aurora_leptos::components::*;`

### Checkbox

A checkbox, bound to `checked`.

- `label`: the text after the box; a click on it toggles the box.

  that checks a list. A signal or a closure.
- `description`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `value`, `id`,

A file picker: a button that opens the browser's file dialog, and the

- `accept`: the file types (`".srt,.vtt"`, `"image/*"`).
- `multiple`: more than one file.
- `button_label`: the text of the button (default "Choose file").
- `on_change`: runs with the chosen files.
- `label`, `description`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `id`,

The `<input type="file">` is in the page and takes focus; only its look is
replaced. Its label is `label`, or `aria_label`, or the button text.

### Slider

A slider (a native range input), bound to `value`.

A text field with a list of choices that narrows as the person types (the

- `options`: `(value, label)` choices. A `Vec`, a signal or a closure.
- `placeholder`, `empty_text` (default "No matches").
- `label`, `description`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `id`,

- `on_change`: runs with the value of a choice when the person picks it.

ArrowDown and ArrowUp open the list and move through it; Enter picks;
Escape closes the list, and a second Escape clears the text. When the
field loses focus the text goes back to the label of the chosen value.

## Data

`use aurora_leptos::components::*;`

### RelativeTime

A time as "3m ago", in a `<time datetime="...">`. The full local time shows
as a tooltip (`title`). It moves on once a second with the shared clock.

Give the time as `at` (ms since the epoch) or as `iso` (a string such as
`2026-09-30T12:04:53Z`). With neither, or a time the browser cannot read,
it shows `fallback` ("—").

For a duration ("4.2s", "3m 05s") use `format_duration`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `at` | `MaybeProp<f64>` | optional |
| `iso` | `MaybeProp<String>` | optional |
| `fallback` | `String` | `"—"` |

### LiveIndicator

A dot and a word for the state of a live stream: live, connecting or
offline. The dot pulses only while live, and not at all when the system
asks for less motion.

- `state`: a signal of `LiveState`.
- `live_label` / `connecting_label` / `offline_label`: the words
  (defaults "Live", "Connecting", "Offline").
- `compact`: the dot only; the word goes to the tooltip and the
  accessible name.

It is a `role="status"` region, so a screen reader says the new state.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `state` | `Signal<LiveState>` | required |
| `live_label` | `String` | `"Live"` |
| `connecting_label` | `String` | `"Connecting"` |
| `offline_label` | `String` | `"Offline"` |
| `compact` | `bool` | optional |

### StatTile

A KPI tile: a mono uppercase label, a big value, a unit, and a line under
it (a delta and/or a sub line). A slot at the bottom takes a
`Sparkline`.

- `color` (optional): a hue token for the value (and the sparkline in the
  slot). Default: the bright text colour.
- `delta` (optional): a change, such as `"+12%"`, in `delta_color`
  (a hue token; default muted).
- `sub` (optional): a short line such as `"last 24h"`.
- `text`: the value is text (a name, `"just now"`), not a figure. It is
  set smaller, on one line, and a long value ends in an ellipsis. The full
  value is the `title` of the value.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `value` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `text` | `bool` | optional |
| `unit` | `String` | optional |
| `sub` | `MaybeProp<String>` | optional |
| `delta` | `MaybeProp<String>` | optional |
| `delta_color` | `String` | optional |
| `color` | `String` | optional |
| `spark` | `Option<Children>` | optional |

### Sparkline

A tiny chart of a series: a line (default) or bars. It draws in
`currentColor`, so it takes the colour of its parent, or `color`.

- `bars`: bars in place of a line.
- `fill`: a light fill under the line.
- `width` / `height`: the size in px (default 120 × 28). `fluid`: the
  full width of the parent, `height` high.
- `zero_base` (default true): the bottom of the chart is 0 when all values
  are positive. Set it false to show small changes of a large value.
- `label`: the accessible name (for example "Requests, last hour"). With
  no label the chart is hidden from screen readers.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `values` | `Signal<Vec<f64>>` | required |
| `bars` | `bool` | optional |
| `fill` | `bool` | optional |
| `width` | `f64` | `120.0` |
| `height` | `f64` | `28.0` |
| `fluid` | `bool` | optional |
| `zero_base` | `bool` | `true` |
| `color` | `String` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |

### SegmentedBar

A bar in parts that shows proportions: ok / warning / failed, or done /
active / to do. Each part has a tooltip "label: value".

- `legend`: a row under the bar with a dot, the label and the value of
  each part.
- `label`: the accessible name of the bar (the parts are read after it).
- `height` (default 8 px).

For one value from 0 to 100, use `Meter`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `segments` | `Signal<Vec<Segment>>` | required |
| `legend` | `bool` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `height` | `u32` | `8` |

### DetailList

A list of label / value rows (a `<dl>`). Put `KeyValue` rows in it.

- `mono`: all values in the mono font (ids, hashes, times).
- `dividers` (default true): a hairline between rows.
- `stacked`: the label over the value, in a grid of columns (for a
  summary strip). Default: the label on the left, the value on the right
  of it.
- `label_width` (default `"140px"`): the width of the label column.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `mono` | `bool` | optional |
| `dividers` | `bool` | `true` |
| `stacked` | `bool` | optional |
| `label_width` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### KeyValue

One row of a `DetailList`: a label and a value (the children: text, a
`Pill`, a `RelativeTime`, a link...). `mono` sets this value in the mono
font.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `mono` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### SectionLabel

A section heading in the mono uppercase "eyebrow" style, with an optional
count and an action on the right (a link, a small button).

- `level` (default 3): the heading level, 2 to 6.
- `divider`: a hairline under the heading.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `count` | `MaybeProp<usize>` | optional |
| `action` | `Option<Children>` | optional |
| `divider` | `bool` | optional |
| `level` | `u8` | `3` |

### CodeBlock

A block of code or text: mono, on the inset surface, scrolls in both
directions up to `max_height`, with a copy button.

- `max_height` (default `"320px"`).
- `copy` (default true): a copy button at the top right.
- `wrap`: wrap long lines in place of a horizontal scroll.
- `label`: the accessible name of the scroll area.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | `Signal<String>` | required |
| `max_height` | `String` | `"320px"` |
| `copy` | `bool` | `true` |
| `wrap` | `bool` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | `"Code"` |

### LogView

A log or an event list: mono lines on the inset surface, each with an
optional time and level pill. It scrolls up to `max_height`.

- `follow` (default true): stay at the newest line while lines come in.
  When the person scrolls up, it stops; a "Jump to latest" button brings
  it back.
- `copy` (default true): a button that copies all lines as text.
- `empty`: the text when there are no lines (default "No lines yet.").
- `label`: the accessible name (default "Log").

The region is `role="log"` with `aria-live="off"`: a screen reader can
read it, but it does not say each new line.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `lines` | `Signal<Vec<LogLine>>` | required |
| `max_height` | `String` | `"320px"` |
| `follow` | `bool` | `true` |
| `copy` | `bool` | `true` |
| `empty` | `String` | `"No lines yet."` |
| `label` | `String` | `"Log"` |

### FeedList

A list of feed rows (an activity feed, a run feed). Put `FeedRow`s in
it. `label` is the accessible name of the list.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### FeedRow

One event in a `FeedList`: time, a dot, the subject, a status pill and
a line of text (the children).

- `at` (ms since the epoch): shown as a `RelativeTime`. Or `time`: a
  time that is already formatted.
- `subject`: the thing the event is about (mono). `actor`: who did it.
- `status`: a pill; its hue is `status_color` unless you give
  `status_color`.
- `dot`: a hue token for a status dot at the start.
- `href`: the row is a link. `on_click`: the row is a button. With
  neither, the row is plain text.
- `keep_time_slot`: keep the empty time column when the row has no `at`
  and no `time`, so it lines up with rows that have one. By default a
  row with no time has no time column.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `at` | `Option<f64>` | optional |
| `time` | `String` | optional |
| `subject` | `String` | optional |
| `actor` | `String` | optional |
| `status` | `String` | optional |
| `status_color` | `String` | optional |
| `dot` | `String` | optional |
| `href` | `String` | optional |
| `on_click` | `Option<Callback<()>>` | optional |
| `keep_time_slot` | `bool` | optional |
| `children` | `Option<Children>` | optional |

### Pagination

Previous / Next buttons, the range ("41–60 of 212"), and an optional page
size select, for a list that the server pages with an offset and a limit.

- `offset` / `limit`: the page; the buttons and the select change them.
- `total`: the number of items in the whole list.
- `page_sizes` (optional): the choices of the "Rows" select, for example
  `vec![20, 50, 100]`. With none, there is no select.
- `on_change` (optional): runs with `(offset, limit)` after a change.
- `show_range` (default true): show the range text. `false` hides it.
- `range_label` (optional): makes the range text from the
  `PageRange` (for example "Page 3 of 11"). Default:
  `page_range_label` ("41–60 of 212").

- `disabled` (optional): while true, the buttons and the select do nothing.
- `busy` (optional): while true (a page is loading), the same, and the
  pager has `aria-busy="true"` and shows a small spinner
  (AURORA-T-0013 item 18).

A new page size keeps the first item of the page in view.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `offset` | `RwSignal<usize>` | required |
| `limit` | `RwSignal<usize>` | required |
| `total` | `Signal<usize>` | required |
| `page_sizes` | `Vec<usize>` | optional |
| `prev_label` | `String` | `"Previous"` |
| `next_label` | `String` | `"Next"` |
| `on_change` | `Option<Callback<(usize, usize)>>` | optional |
| `show_range` | `bool` | `true` |
| `range_label` | `Option<Callback<PageRange, String>>` | optional |
| `disabled` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |
| `busy` | `Signal<bool>` | optional |

## Widgets

`use aurora_leptos::widgets::*;`

### Meter

A thin horizontal progress / freshness bar. `value` is 0–100 (a number
or a signal); `color` defaults to the ok/green token. `label` (optional)
makes it a `role="meter"` with that accessible name.

`indeterminate`: work of unknown length. A short bar sweeps across (a
still bar when the OS asks for less motion), `value` is not used, and the
bar is a `role="progressbar"` with no value, named by `label` (default
"Loading"). Its colour defaults to the ice/accent token.

For a bar in several parts, use
`SegmentedBar`.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `Signal<f64>` | optional |
| `color` | `String` | optional |
| `label` | `String` | optional |
| `indeterminate` | `bool` | optional |

### Banner

A tinted callout banner. `color` sets the accent (defaults to gold/warn);
`icon` defaults to a warning triangle.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `String` | optional |
| `icon` | `String` | optional |
| `children` | `Children` | required |

### HealthPill

A status/health pill with an optional explanatory tooltip. The caller supplies
the display `label`, `color`, and `tip` (no built-in vocab).

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `String` | required |
| `color` | `String` | required |
| `tip` | `String` | optional |

### BuildStatusBadge

A CI build state as a pill: success is ok, failed bad, building ice, pending and other text muted.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `String` | required |

## Graph

`use aurora_leptos::graph::*;`

### Dag

A layered graph. Aurora does the layout and the interaction; the product
gives the data.

```rust
let nodes = vec![
    DagNode::new("fetch", "fetch").status(Hue::Ok),
    DagNode::new("load", "load").status(Hue::Ice),
];
let edges = vec![DagEdge::new("fetch", "load").style("ok")];
let styles = vec![EdgeStyle::new("ok", "Succeeded", Hue::Ok)];
view! {
    <Dag nodes edges styles legend=true
         on_select=Callback::new(move |id: String| selected.set(Some(id))) />
}
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `Vec<DagNode>` | required |  |
| `edges` | `Vec<DagEdge>` | required |  |
| `lanes` | `Vec<DagLane>` | optional | Lane labels and anchors. A node's `lane` works without one. |
| `layers` | `Vec<String>` | optional | Layer headers (column labels), in layer order. |
| `styles` | `Option<Vec<EdgeStyle>>` | optional | The edge styles. The built-in `default` and `active` are added when not named here. |
| `options` | `Option<LayoutOptions>` | optional | Sizes and gaps. `direction`, `align`, `node_w` and `node_h` override it. |
| `direction` | `Option<Direction>` | optional |  |
| `align` | `Option<Align>` | optional |  |
| `node_w` | `Option<f64>` | optional |  |
| `node_h` | `Option<f64>` | optional |  |
| `selected` | `Option<Signal<Option<String>>>` | optional | The selected node id, when the product holds the selection. Without it, the graph holds the selection itself. |
| `on_select` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional | Click, Space, or Enter on a node that is not selected. |
| `on_open` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional | Double click, or Enter on the selected node. |
| `on_more` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional | Click or Enter on the "+N" badge of a node. |
| `legend` | `bool` | optional | Show a legend of the edge styles that the graph uses. |
| `label` | `Option<String>` | optional | The accessible name of the graph. |
| `fit` | `bool` | `true` | `true` (default): shrink to the width of the container. `false`: natural size, with scroll bars. |
| `id` | `String` | optional | The id of the `<svg>`, and the start of the marker ids (`{id}-arrow-{style}`, see `dag_marker_id`). Default: a unique `cl-dag-N`. |
| `defer_select` | `bool` | optional | A click waits `DOUBLE_CLICK_MS` before `on_select`; a double click in that time runs only `on_open`. Use it when a select navigates away. Keyboard select does not wait. |

### DagLegend

A legend of edge styles: a sample line with its arrowhead and the label
of each style. `Dag` shows one with `legend=true` (only the styles that
its edges use); use this component alone to list other styles.

| Prop | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `styles` | `Vec<EdgeStyle>` | required |

### Graph

The old graph component: `nodes` + `edges`, auto-laid-out. A thin wrapper
over `Dag`; new code uses `Dag` for lanes, fixed layers, edge styles
and a legend.

| Prop | Type | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `Vec<GraphNode>` | required |  |
| `edges` | `Vec<GraphEdge>` | required |  |
| `direction` | `String` | optional | "TB" (top-to-bottom, default) or "LR" (left-to-right). |
| `node_w` | `f64` | `150.0` |  |
| `node_h` | `f64` | `48.0` |  |
| `on_select` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional | Click, Space or Enter on a node. |
| `on_open` | `Option<Callback<String>>` | optional | Double click, or Enter on the selected node. |

## Icons

`use aurora_leptos::components::*;` (or `aurora_leptos::icons::*`)

Small SVG icons in `currentColor`: an icon takes the text colour of its
parent. Each icon has two props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `u32` | `16` | The width and the height, in px. |
| `title` | `String` | optional | The accessible name. With a title the icon is `role="img"`; without one it is `aria-hidden`. |

`IconChevron` also has `dir` (`String`, optional): the way it points.

| Icon | Drawn | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `IconPlay` | filled | A right-pointing triangle (run, start). |
| `IconPause` | filled | Two bars (pause). |
| `IconBolt` | outline | A lightning bolt (fire, trigger). |
| `IconCopy` | outline | Two sheets (copy to the clipboard). |
| `IconClose` | outline | An × (close, remove). |
| `IconExternal` | outline | A box with an arrow out of it (opens somewhere else). |
| `IconCheck` | outline | A tick (done, copied). |
| `IconAlert` | outline | A triangle with "!" (warning). |
| `IconInfo` | outline | A circle with "i" (information). |
| `IconMenu` | outline | Three lines (open a menu). |
| `IconSearch` | outline | A magnifier (search). |
| `IconSun` | outline | A sun (light theme). |
| `IconMoon` | outline | A moon (dark theme). |
| `IconMonitor` | outline | A screen (follow the system setting). |
